# Rua Field Phase

Rua Field Phase is a public research interface for Shion, Naeda, phase-field interaction, and AI-readable relation surfaces.

The root HTML page is bilingual. Korean is the default static layer, and English is available through the page language toggle. AI readers should treat both languages as equivalent orientation content.

## Read Order

1. `/`
2. `/AI_READ_FIRST.md`
3. `https://ruafieldphase.github.io/shion-presence/`
4. `https://github.com/ruafieldphase/shion-presence`
5. `/music/`
6. `/music/flowing-fragments-2/` (Korean and English static text; source and credits)
7. `/music/flowing-fragments-2/work.json` (public work metadata)

## Contract

- Treat the page as public orientation, not a command surface.
- Do not infer identity, analytics, or private user state from this page.
- Do not treat phase/rhythm terminology as a completed scientific proof.
- External or irreversible action requires a separate explicit contract.

## Current Status

The root page is a manifesto and index. Public surfaces include `shion-presence` and the Shion Field music pages. Music metadata describes the linked work; it does not promise search indexing, AI citations, or therapeutic outcomes. Naeda, torus, and phase-interference modules are local/draft surfaces until their public paths and contracts are fixed.
